name_original: AT&T GoPhone - Microsoft Lumia 640 4G LTE with 8GB Memory No-Contract Cell Phone - Black
description_original: Microsoft 640 No-Contract Cell Phone for AT&T GoPhone: Stay connected and productive wherever you are with this no-contract cell phone, which features 4G LTE speed and Wi-Fi for flexible Internet connection options. Easily browse Web sites and flip through features using the 5" touch screen, and snap photos with the 8.0MP rear-facing camera.
